purpose: Verify documents render as readable curated fields with working inter-document links. AC-202-1 is pending: its static-files-no-server clause predates the Phase 3.8 server-only view (see test-suites/PENDING.md).
title: Browsable page rendering

testCases.description: renderPage renders curated key fields as readable text rather than raw JSON
testCases.testPointer: test/view/html-page.test.js::renderPage renders curated key fields, not raw JSON (AC-202-2)

testCases.description: document links render as anchors targeting the raw doc id section
testCases.testPointer: test/view/doc-renderers/helpers.test.js::docLink renders an anchor to the raw id

testCases.description: the rendered page is a valid HTML5 document
testCases.testPointer: test/view/html-page.test.js::renderPage emits a valid HTML5 document (AC-202-1)

testCases.description: the view serves from a local server process and never writes files to disk
testCases.testPointer: test/view/cli.test.js::rcf audit view never writes any files to disk (regression against static mode)

testCases.description: style.css nav.tabs has flex-shrink: 0 and no min-width: 0, so the tablist never clips the Build tab under a long project name
testCases.testPointer: test/view/shell-header-layout.test.js::AC-202-4: nav.tabs cannot shrink below its intrinsic width

testCases.description: style.css .tools has flex-shrink: 0 so the Find button and theme control never shrink into the tablist
testCases.testPointer: test/view/shell-header-layout.test.js::AC-202-4: .tools cannot shrink below its intrinsic width

testCases.description: style.css .product has min-width: 0 so it yields to the tablist and tools before clipping anything
style.css .product .name has min-width: 0 so text-overflow: ellipsis triggers inside the flex .product
testCases.testPointer: test/view/shell-header-layout.test.js::AC-202-4: .product .name has min-width:0 so the ellipsis triggers

testCases.description: renderPage emits a title="<full name>" attribute on .product .name so hover reveals the whole name under ellipsis
the title attribute shares the escapeHtml path with the inner text so a projectName of "<script>" renders as title="<script>"
testCases.testPointer: test/view/shell-header-layout.test.js::AC-202-5: the title attribute is HTML-escaped alongside the body

testCases.description: no title attribute is emitted when the product block collapses (no projectName)
testCases.testPointer: test/view/shell-header-layout.test.js::AC-202-5: no title attribute when the product block collapses

testCases.description: resolveProductHeader prefers prd.productName over manifest.projectName when both are set
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-name-precedence.test.js::AC-202-6: prd.productName wins over manifest.projectName when both are set

testCases.description: resolveProductHeader falls back to manifest.projectName when the PRD carries no productName
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-name-precedence.test.js::AC-202-6: manifest.projectName is the first fallback when PRD has no productName

testCases.description: resolveProductHeader falls back to prd.productTitle when neither productName nor manifest is set
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-name-precedence.test.js::AC-202-6: prd.productTitle is the last fallback (brief-stage trees without productName or manifest)

testCases.description: the renderPage DOM reflects the flipped precedence; the manifest value does not reach the header slice when prd.productName is set
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-name-precedence.test.js::AC-202-6: renderPage reflects the flipped precedence in the DOM
